data.name: ForwardProxyHandlerConnects
data.value: ConfigureHandler set {0} on a forward-proxy handler. The forward proxy connects to each destination itself, so it can check the address it connects to: ConnectCallback must stay null and UseProxy false.

data.name: ForwardProxyNotRegistered
data.value: UseForwardProxy places the middleware that builder.Services.AddForwardProxy(proxy => ...) registers, and no forward proxy is registered. Call AddForwardProxy with the rules that say which destinations clients may reach.

data.name: ForwardProxyTunnelConnects
data.value: ForwardProxyOptions.Tunnel.ConnectCallback is set. The forward proxy connects each tunnel itself, so it can check the address it connects to.

data.name: HandlerCannotProxy
data.value: ConfigureHandler turned on {0}. A proxy relays redirects, cookies and encoded bodies as the destination sends them, so AllowAutoRedirect and UseCookies must stay false and AutomaticDecompression must stay None.

data.name: ReverseProxyNotRegistered
data.value: UseReverseProxy places the middleware that builder.Services.AddReverseProxy(proxy => ...) registers, and no reverse proxy is registered. Call AddReverseProxy with the routes to forward.

data.name: RouteDestinationInvalid
data.value: Route '{0}' has the destination '{1}', which is not an absolute http or https URI without a query, a fragment or user information.

data.name: RouteDestinationsMissing
data.value: Route '{0}' has no destination. A reverse-proxy route needs at least one.

data.name: RouteHostPatternEmpty
data.value: Route '{0}' has an empty host pattern.

data.name: RouteHostPatternInvalid
data.value: Route '{0}' has a host pattern that is not valid. {1}

data.name: RouteHostsNull
data.value: Route '{0}' has a null host list. Leave Hosts empty to match any host.

data.name: RouteNameDuplicate
data.value: More than one reverse-proxy route is named '{0}'. Route names must be unique.

data.name: RouteNameMissing
data.value: The route at index {0} has no name. Each reverse-proxy route needs a unique name.

data.name: RouteNull
data.value: The route at index {0} is null.

data.name: RoutePathPrefixInvalid
data.value: Route '{0}' has the path prefix '{1}', which is not an absolute path without '.' or '..' segments.

data.name: RuleHostPatternEmpty
data.value: The rule at index {0} has an empty host pattern.

data.name: RuleHostPatternInvalid
data.value: The rule at index {0} has a host pattern that is not valid. {1}

data.name: RuleHostsMissing
data.value: The rule at index {0} names no host. A forward-proxy rule needs at least one host pattern; '*' allows any host.

data.name: RuleNull
data.value: The rule at index {0} is null.

data.name: RulePortInvalid
data.value: The rule at index {0} allows port {1}, which is not from 1 to 65535.

data.name: RulePortsNull
data.value: The rule at index {0} has a null port list. Leave Ports empty to allow the default ports.
